rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for ordinary non-poetic writing as a literary form.

example.english: I usually prefer reading prose to poetry.
example.traditional: 我平時鍾意睇散文，多過睇詩。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 si4 zung1 ji3 tai2 saan2 man4 do1 gwo3 tai2 si1

rows.note: Use this for dull, un imaginative writing that merely records events in a tedious sequence.

example.english: Your work report is just dull prose, merely listing what happened item by item.
example.traditional: 你份工作報告寫到成篇流水帳，淨係逐項記低發生過咩事。
example.jyutping: nei5 fan2 gung1 zok3 bou3 gou3 se2 dou3 sing4 pin1 lau4 seoi2 zoeng3 zing6 hai6 zuk6 hong6 gei3 dai1 faat3 saang1 gwo3 me1 si6

rows.note: Use this for dull discourse made up of trite or commonplace remarks rather than specifically for its writing style.

example.english: The speech consisted of nothing but commonplace prose and had no original ideas.
example.traditional: 該番演說盡是老生常談，內容毫無新意。
example.jyutping: goi1 faan1 jin2 syut3 zeon6 si6 lou5 sang1 soeng4 taam4 noi6 jung4 hou4 mou4 san1 ji3
